package main

import (
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"

	choices "choices.test"
)

func main() {
	flag := true
	text := "hi"
	data := []byte{}
	status := choices.Status(1)
	updated := time.Unix(1700000000, 123000000).UTC()
	delay := 1500 * time.Millisecond
	id := uuid.MustParse("0102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f10")
	zero := int32(0)
	cert := func(v choices.CertSourceValueOneof) []byte {
		m := choices.CertSource{Value: v}
		return m.Encode()
	}
	scalar := func(v choices.ScalarChoiceValueOneof) []byte {
		m := choices.ScalarChoice{Value: choices.Maybe[choices.ScalarChoiceValueOneof]{Value: v, Present: true}}
		return m.Encode()
	}
	none := choices.ScalarChoice{}
	coverage := choices.Coverage{Choice: choices.Maybe[choices.CoverageChoiceOneof]{Value: choices.CoverageChoiceOneof{Number: &zero}, Present: true}}
	cases := map[string][]byte{
		"cert_acme":       cert(choices.CertSourceValueOneof{Acme: &choices.AcmeCertSource{Email: "ops@example.com", Domains: []string{"a", "b"}}}),
		"cert_secret":     cert(choices.CertSourceValueOneof{Secret: &choices.SecretCertSource{Name: "n", Secret: []byte{1, 2, 3}}}),
		"scalar_flag":     scalar(choices.ScalarChoiceValueOneof{Flag: &flag}),
		"scalar_text":     scalar(choices.ScalarChoiceValueOneof{Text: &text}),
		"scalar_data":     scalar(choices.ScalarChoiceValueOneof{Data: &data}),
		"scalar_status":   scalar(choices.ScalarChoiceValueOneof{Status: &status}),
		"scalar_updated":  scalar(choices.ScalarChoiceValueOneof{Updated: &updated}),
		"scalar_delay":    scalar(choices.ScalarChoiceValueOneof{Delay: &delay}),
		"scalar_uuid":     scalar(choices.ScalarChoiceValueOneof{Uuid: &id}),
		"scalar_none":     none.Encode(),
		"coverage_number": coverage.Encode(),
	}
	out := map[string]string{}
	for name, wire := range cases {
		out[name] = hex.EncodeToString(wire)
	}
	json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(out)
}
